turns.question: Our project concerns joining catalog updates to an event stream with explicit Serdes. For the planned deployment, set application.id to maple-enrich-17. Which value should we use, and which ordering of processing and offset saving gives at-least-once consumption?

asks: project application.id
Which ordering of processing and offset saving gives at-least-once consumption?
turns.answer: The project application.id is maple-enrich-17. Read, process, then save the position gives at-least-once consumption.
key_facts: Read, process, then save the position gives at-least-once consumption.

evidence.quote: set application.id to maple-enrich-17
| Read → process → save position | First messages are re-processed by the new owner | **At least once** |

turns.answer: The project catalog topic name is maple-catalog-43. Partition count caps consumer parallelism.
key_facts: The project catalog topic name is maple-catalog-43.
